title: Binance hit by crypto hack worth billions
caption:
Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, says a security breach has an estimated impact of $6.3 billion – possibly the biggest crypto theft ever. $2.54 billion has been frozen so far and withdrawals are paused. Binance says it will cover all losses while it investigates with law enforcement.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
